rationale: The new SEN-D1 sensor repeatedly failed pairing with "pairing expired" (120s timeout) despite being within 1m of the base station, correct pairing mode, and available capacity (5/16 bound). The standard L1 fix — factory-resetting the sensor (SYNC 15s until white LED) then re-pairing — resolved the issue on the next attempt, confirming a stale/partial binding state on the peripheral itself rather than a system-level fault.

repair_steps: Confirm the new sensor is now paired and appears online in the app.
Advise the customer to move the sensor to its intended location and verify signal strength.
Close the case as resolved at frontline.

results.text: HB-100 owner could not add a new door sensor; app showed E-201. Base station already had 8 devices. Customer removed an old test sensor and pairing succeeded. Resolved at frontline.

Put the base station into pairing mode from the app (Add Device). Then hold the SYNC button on the camera or sensor for 3 seconds until its LED blinks blue. Keep the peripheral within 1 metre of the base station during pairing. Pairing times out after 120 seconds. After pairing, the device can be moved to its final location.

Hold SYNC for 15 seconds until the LED flashes white. This removes the peripheral's own binding but does not remove it from the base station table; remove it in the app first, then reset, then pair again.
